character: 90 km sunny southern Alps resort at 1,780 m. Good snow record, family-friendly.
name: Les Orres
description: 100km of pistes, 20 lifts, in the Ubaye valley (Southern Alps). The largest ski area in the Southern Alps. Known for: exceptional sunshine (300+ days/year), a heated outdoor pool at 1,800m, extensive snowmaking (95% coverage — among the highest in France), and being more affordable than the northern Alps. Good for families and intermediates.

suitability.families: Very good — heated outdoor pool at 1,800m
